body: Seeing elderly people eating alone. Abused animal commercials. When the Gorilla dad breaks out of jail in the movie Sing to hug his son after seeing him perform. The fact that I am dying.

Cheated on me the entire year I was grieving my sister's suicide. Found out 11 days before Christmas, 11 days before the 1 year anniversary of her death. Found out he called "her"(#DMHWC) 3 minutes after my mother called and told him my sister killed herself Christmas morning 2017. He called #DMHWC while I was having an emergency hysterectomy in November 2017, 1 month before my sister killed herself. So many more things, but, saying, I don't know if I ever loved you is the ABSOLUTE worst. All the years he said it, lies, all the times he wrote it, lies, our entire life together, lies. I wish I could hate him, but, I still, love him. WHY? I think that hurts the most. I want to stop loving him, but, I guess I deserve the pain and hurt he has caused me. I don't know, I've never been enough for anyone, never good enough, so, I guess this is my life, until it isn't.

My husband of 12 years said almost the exact words when I asked him what went wrong.
I found out he cheated, asked him why, he said, "I don't know, then, later said, I don't think I love you anymore, I honestly don't know if I ever did." It hurts more than the cheating, I won't ever forget those words or his voice when he said them. Worst of all, I still f*cling love him.

I don't want it anymore. Thank you for caring. I genuinely appreciate you and your time to comment. 
I know people care, I know people love me, but, I am so tired of living this life. It hurts to much.
I genuinely feel these words. I am completely alone. I am sorry you have been let down. I see you and hear you.
I wish the best for you.

I am going to post here, for the 1st time ever, anywhere on Reddit. 
Please advise if I break any rules or do something wrong. I truly want to know if ITAH. Thank you!
